_comment: Curated context-window facts (vendor-verified) for live SAIA models that the GWDG docs table has not caught up with yet (the new B200 platform models). Docs rows supersede these entries; any live model missing here falls back to the assumed platform max (1M) per the relaxed never-guess rule.
